Definition: Ben-Oni, the original name of Benjamin
BiblicalUsage: Ben-Oni means "son of my sorrow." He was the name given to Benjamin by Rachel. You will find it in Genesis 35:18.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Ben-Oni matters because God remembers names the world forgets.
